title: Synthetic Universe Generator — Overview and definition
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods and framings developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. PROPOSED CAPABILITY TARGET. Some entries build on existing research; others would require major scientific breakthroughs, new hardware, or extensive engineering. Produces configurable virtual environments for scientific, educational, and computational experiments. A proposed generator of entire virtual universes: configurable physics, environments, and populations for scientific experiments, education, and computational research. Each universe ships with its ground truth, so algorithms tested inside it can be scored against reality-as-defined.
